nodes.name: MOF Assembly
nodes.procedure: Co(NO₃)₂ and Nd(NO₃)₃ (nNd/nCo = 0.2) as the metal salts, 2-methylimidazole (2-MIM) as the organic ligands, and cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide (CTAB) as a surfactant were assembled into Nd-incorporated zeolitic imidazolate framework-67 (Nd-ZIF-67) under stirring in water solution. Unlike the traditional ZIF-67 synthesis in nonaqueous solvents (e.g., methanol and N,N-dimethylformamide), the current strategy has the characteristics of reacting rapidly and environmentally friendly.

unit_operations.name: Stirring Assembly
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: assembled into Nd-incorporated zeolitic imidazolate framework-67 (Nd-ZIF-67) under the stirring in water solution

nodes.source_text: As schematically illustrated in Figure 2a, the Co(NO3)2 and Nd(NO3)3 (nNd/nCo = 0.2) as the metal salts, 2-methylimidazole (2-MIM) as the organic ligands, and cetyl trimethyl ammonium bromide (CTAB) as a surfactant were assembled into Nd-incorporated zeolitic imidazolate framework-67 (Nd-ZIF-67) under the stirring in water solution.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nd/Co@NC shows only signals of metallic Co (JCPDS: 15-0806) with no diffraction peaks of Nd species due to low Nd content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: After pyrolysis, only the signals of Co (JCPDS: 15-0806) was shown in the XRD pattern of Nd/Co@NC (Figure 2b), while there are no diffraction peaks of Nd species, which may be due to the low content of Nd.

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP confirms Nd content in Nd/Co@NC to be 1.53 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The coupled plasma (ICP) result confirms the Nd content in Nd/Co@NC to be as low as 1.53 wt.%.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nd 3d XPS peaks at 1134.6 eV and 1164.5 eV confirm Nd³⁺. Co 2p XPS shows Co²⁺ species with metallic Co (778.5 eV, 794.2 eV) and 0.34 eV negative shift after Nd doping indicating strong electronic interaction.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Nd 3d XPS spectrum (Figure 2c), the two fitting peaks at the binding energies of 1134.6 and 1164.5 eV ... are attributed to trivalent Nd³⁺. The existence of metallic Co was also evidenced by the zero-valence state peaks of Co at the binding energies of 778.5 and 794.2 eV. Moreover, after the combination of Nd, the binding energy of Co 2p 3/2 for Nd/Co@NC is negatively shifted by ≈0.34 eV compared to that of Co@NC.

nodes.characterization_summary: ID/IG ratios of 0.94 for Nd/Co@NC and 0.98 for Co@NC indicate increased graphitization degree.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The ratios between the intensity of D and G bands (ID/IG) of Nd/Co@NC and Co@NC are 0.94 and 0.98 respectively, revealing the increased graphitization degree.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nd-ZIF-67 shows well-defined cubic structure with average size ≈300 nm. Nd/Co@NC retains morphology with rough, concave surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 3a,b, the Nd-ZIF-67 precursor presents a well-defined cubic structure with an average size of ≈300 nm. ... After thermal pyrolysis, the Nd/Co@NC retains the structure and morphology integrity of Nd-ZIF-67 nanocubes, but the surface was transformed into rough and concave architecture.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nd/Co@NC shows Co particles of 6.2 nm average size with HRTEM lattice fringes of 0.211 nm (111) and 0.186 nm (200) planes of metallic Co.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A large number of Nd/Co particles are uniformly dispersed in N-doped carbon surface with an average size of around 6.2 nm. ... The lattice fringes with 0.211 nm and 0.186 nm were clearly observed, which respectively corresponds to the (111) and (200) plane of metallic Co.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX elemental mapping shows homogeneous distribution of Nd, Co, N, C elements in Nd-ZIF-67 and Nd/Co@NC.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EDX elemental mapping (Figure 3c) shows the homogeneous distribution of Nd, Co, N, and C elements in Nd-ZIF-67. ... The homogeneous distribution of the Nd, Co, C, and N elements was further revealed by EDX element mapping images.

nodes.characterization_summary: Nd/Co@NC has large specific surface area of 270.2 m²/g.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The rough and concave surface endows Nd/Co@NC with a large specific surface area of 270.2 m²g⁻¹, as verified by N₂ adsorption-desorption isotherms.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman during OER shows Co-O (E_g: 460-480 cm⁻¹, A_1g: 690 cm⁻¹) and Co-OOH (A_g: 530-550 cm⁻¹) formation with transformation sequence OH⁻ → Co-O → Co-OOH → O₂.
nodes.evidence_snippet: When the bias potential increased from 0.2 V to 0.8 V ... three characteristic peaks stretching over 460 cm⁻¹-480 cm⁻¹, 530 cm⁻¹-550 cm⁻¹, and at 690 cm⁻¹ ... the broad peak stretching over 460 cm⁻¹-480 cm⁻¹ represents the E_g vibrational mode of Co-O species; and the broad peak stretching over 530 cm⁻¹-550 cm⁻¹ is assigned to the A_g vibrational mode of Co-OOH species.
